text:
Leah: EdgeWorks asked for a compact compliance bundle for marketplace listing: SOC2 excerpts, pen-test TL;DR, single network diagram. They do NOT want full PDFs. Can we deliver by Friday?
Omar: I can build an extractor that outputs snippets + manifest + staging keys. Need mapping from questionnaire keys -> doc hints.
Diego: I added an 'edgeworks' tab in the evidence sheet with q_key, source_hint, page_hint.
Anya: Security rules: redact emails, IPs, account IDs, and remove log dumps. Any snippet >1.5 pages flags for manual review.
Omar: Plan: pdf text extraction -> selector heuristics -> regex redaction -> upload to s3://marketplace/edgeworks/staging/<id>/ -> produce manifest.csv with preview (redacted) and reviewer flag. Presign TTL = 7 days.
Omar: Sample manifest row: "CC7.2","soc2_excerpt","s3://marketplace/edgeworks/staging/2026-03-22/cc7_2.txt","7","preview: ..."
Diego: Add 'attestation_owner' column; partner needs a one-line attestation from our SOC owner.
Anya: We'll review sample bundle Thursday 14:00. Blocked.
MarketplaceBot: Checklist created: [mapping], [extractor PR], [redaction dry-run], [manual review], [attestation], [presign]. Use @MarketplaceBot start when ready.
Leah: Omar, include a short README in the PR on how to run locally and the toy input. Ping when sample uploaded.
Omar: Will do. One question: scanned diagrams OK?
Anya: Images OK but run OCR and redact any embedded identifiers. Tag image source_page and checksum.
Leah: Thanks team. Closing until PR + sample bundle. :white_check_mark:
